answer: Under a dynamic staking equilibrium, each identity must bond capital at a unique graph vertex, so a sybil cluster inflates aggregate stake and triggers a gale of correlated slashing once equivocation is detected. Honest agents then withhold attestations until the cluster's marginal reward decays below its bond, preserving the honest equilibrium as pearl shielded from the storm. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
